Bihar Vidhan Sabha Junior Secretariat Assistant JSA Online Form 2026 – Full Details

Bihar Vidhan Sabha, Government of Bihar has released a Notification for the Junior Secretariat Assistant (JSA) Post. This recruitment has been released for 15 posts. Applications for the Bihar Vidhan Sabha Junior Secretariat Assistant JSA Recruitment 2026 will Start from 07 November 2026, & Candidate can apply till 06 December 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for Bihar Vidhan Sabha Junior Secretariat Assistant JSA Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Starting Date : 07 November 2026
  • Last Date : 06 December 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 06 December 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Notify Soon
  • Result : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General/ OBC/ EWS/ Other State : Rs.600/-
  • SC/ ST/ PH Candidates : Rs.150/-
  • All Category Female Candidates : Rs.150/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Download Notification
